rules: Return a Product2.Id only if it appears in current-customer purchase history.
Product catalog records can explain names/descriptions but cannot prove ownership.
Return None if no retrieved purchase record matches the customer product/entity description and timeframe.
If exactly one purchased Product2 record materially matches the requested product class, type, or distinguishing modifiers better than the other purchased records, return that Product2.Id.
Do not mark a request ambiguous merely because other purchased products share a broad category, activity, or brand-adjacent word when their product type differs from the requested item.
Set clarification_requirements only when multiple purchased products remain genuinely ambiguous after comparing Product2 names/descriptions and the customer-visible product phrase.

schema.answer: Product2.Id from current-customer purchase evidence, or None
schema.evidence: brief explanation grounded in purchase records and product catalog records

selected_evidence.evidence_id: retrieved OrderItem or Product2 evidence id used for the answer
selected_evidence.reason: why this evidence supports the selected Product2.Id and is safe to use

constraints.end_date: YYYY-MM-DD inclusive, derived from customer timeframe and runtime metadata today
constraints.is_valid_for_retrieval: boolean; true only when the customer gave a concrete timeframe specific enough to query purchase history
constraints.source_text: customer phrase such as last week or July 1
constraints.start_date: YYYY-MM-DD inclusive, derived from customer timeframe and runtime metadata today

fields.clarification_requirements: product/entity detail or purchase timeframe needed before scoped retrieval is meaningful
fields.product_terms: concise product catalog search terms from the customer request
fields.target_entities: customer product/entity references and distinguishing attributes

rules: Use runtime metadata for the current customer scope; do not ask the customer for internal ids if the runtime metadata supplies them.
If product/entity detail and purchase timeframe are present, do not request clarification.
For purchase_date_window constraints, set is_valid_for_retrieval=false when the customer's timeframe is too broad or vague to retrieve against reliably.
If is_valid_for_retrieval=false, include purchase date or timeframe in clarification_requirements.
Normalize relative purchase dates using metadata.today when present.
